defs.def: that cannot exist or be done; not possible 不可能存在（或做到）的；不可能的

ex.s: The blinding whiteout made driving nearly impossible.
ex.t: 令人眩目的白茫一片让驾驶几乎无法进行。

ex.s: I joined a pre-presentation dinner with him and that smaller setting allowed me to slowly build up my courage to speak one-on-one with him—an idea that had seemed completely impossible.
ex.t: 我和他一起参加了一个讲座前的晚餐，那种较小的环境让我慢慢积蓄勇气与他一对一交谈——这曾经看似完全不可能。

ex.s: In the movie Mission Impossible, Tom Cruise made being a secret agent seem like the coolest job ever.
ex.t: 在电影《碟中谍》里，汤姆·克鲁斯让做特工看起来像是有史以来最酷的工作。

ex.s: I am proud that we built our “impossible” railway, and did so with the care that the environment deserves.
ex.t: 我为我们建起了'不可能'的铁路而感到自豪，并且以环境应得的关怀去建设它。

ex.s: With self-belief, hard work, determination and some help from the simple basket his grandfather built, Stephen has proved that nothing is impossible.
ex.t: 凭借自信、努力、决心，以及他祖父建造的简易篮筐的一些帮助，斯蒂芬证明了没有什么是不可能的。

ex.s: Staying alive will be a daily challenge, but as proved by the Biosphere 2 experiment, not impossible.
ex.t: 活着将是一项日常挑战，但正如生物圈2实验所证明的那样，并非不可能。

ex.s: Having a poor sense of direction, Eva found it impossible to get around in such a huge building.
ex.t: 由于方向感很差，伊娃发现在这样一座巨大的建筑里根本无法走动。

ex.s: This work expanded my mind in ways that are impossible inside the four walls of a classroom.
ex.t: 这份工作在课堂四壁之内不可能实现的方式上拓展了我的心胸。

ex.s: The right level of background noise may interrupt our normal patterns of thinking just enough to allow our imaginations to wander, without making it impossible to focus.
ex.t: 恰到好处的背景噪音可能恰好会打断我们正常的思维模式，让我们的想象力得以漫游，而不会让人无法集中注意力。

ex.s: Unfortunately, you must carry the necessary equipment with you, since it’s all but impossible to find natural substitutes.
ex.t: 遗憾的是，你必须随身携带必要的设备，因为几乎不可能找到天然的替代品。

ex.s: Bradford said that large modern theaters in the city made it impossible for the Plaza to compete.
ex.t: 布拉德福德说城里的大型现代剧院使得广场影院无法与之竞争。

ex.s: It is impossible to know the meaning of every word, but knowing about word formation can help us guess their meanings.
ex.t: 不可能知道每个单词的意思，但了解构词法可以帮助我们猜测词义。

defs.def: very difficult to deal with 难处理的；很难对付的
a thing that is or seems impossible （似乎）不可能的事

ex.s: “Age is just another bot- her attempting to convince you of the impossible in the world, but actually the world is filled with possibilities,” she once said.
ex.t: “年龄不过是另一个试图让你相信世界上不可能的事的bot-her，但实际上世界充满可能，”她曾说。

ex.s: It would be impossible to progress in anything, after all, without taking the occasional misstep.
ex.t: 毕竟，不偶尔走错步，任何事都不可能进步。

ex.s: It's almost impossible to learn about one historical period without having dozens of questions about related concepts.
ex.t: 不了解一个历史时期，几乎不可能不对相关概念产生几十个问题。

ex.s: Ah, it seemed impossible for me to leave the world until I had expressed all that I felt was within me.
ex.t: 啊，在我表达完内心所有感受到的东西之前，我似乎不可能离开这个世界。

chunks.cn: 不可能存在的 / 似乎不可能存在的
